import json, random, subprocess, sys, time
import gen, check

def main():
    seed = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 0
    count = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 50
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    reqs = [gen.gen_request(rng) for _ in range(count)]
    data = ("\n".join(json.dumps(r) for r in reqs) + "\n").encode()
    t0 = time.time()
    proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/app/submission/planner.py"], input=data,
                          capture_output=True, timeout=600)
    dt = time.time() - t0
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        print("PLANNER FAILED rc=%s" % proc.returncode)
        print(proc.stderr.decode()[-3000:])
        return 1
    lines = proc.stdout.decode().splitlines()
    if len(lines) != len(reqs):
        print("LINE COUNT MISMATCH %d != %d" % (len(lines), len(reqs)))
        print(proc.stderr.decode()[-2000:])
        return 1
    bad = 0
    stats = {"optimal": 0, "infeasible": 0, "invalid": 0}
    for req, line in zip(reqs, lines):
        try:
            resp = json.loads(line)
        except Exception as exc:
            print("BAD JSON:", exc, line[:200]); bad += 1; continue
        stats[resp.get("status", "?")] = stats.get(resp.get("status", "?"), 0) + 1
        errs = check.check(req, resp)
        if errs:
            bad += 1
            print("FAIL:", errs)
            print("  req:", json.dumps(req)[:600])
            print("  resp:", line[:600])
    print("seed=%s count=%d bad=%d stats=%s time=%.2fs" % (seed, count, bad, stats, dt))
    if proc.stderr:
        print("stderr:", proc.stderr.decode()[-2000:])
    return 1 if bad else 0

sys.exit(main())
